history.content: Should I be worried about anything before Friday?

Sarah at the VC firm is still waiting on the updated deck. If Friday matters to her, that's the one with a real deadline attached. 3. Dana's panel email mentions a 45 minute product case and questions to bring, I don't see that panel on your calendar, so it may already be past or unscheduled. Calendar itself is clean after today: dentist Tue 9am, standup and dinner with Dana Wednesday, then Thursday and Friday are wide open. No conflicts. Want me to draft replies to Sam or Sarah?
